name: claude-commit-msg
description: Generate git commit messages from your diff with your local Claude Code CLI (Haiku by default).

claudeCommitMsg.prompt.default:
Write a concise git commit message for the diff on stdin.

Look at the past 15 commit messages (`git log -15 --format=%B`) and match their style: Conventional Commits type, scope names, casing and language. If they follow no clear convention, use Conventional Commits.

- Subject: imperative mood, under 72 characters, no trailing period.
- Add a short body only when the change is not obvious from the subject: explain what changed and why, wrapped at 72 characters.
- Describe only what the diff shows. Do not invent motivation, ticket numbers or trailers.
claudeCommitMsg.prompt.markdownDescription: Instructions sent to Claude. The diff arrives on stdin. Claude may run read-only git commands (`git log`, `git show`, `git diff`, `git status`).

claudeCommitMsg.model.markdownDescription: Model used to write commit messages. Pick one here or run **Claude: Select Commit Message Model**, which also accepts a custom model ID or alias.

claudeCommitMsg.claudePath.markdownDescription: Path to the `claude` CLI. Set the full path (for example `~/.local/bin/claude`) if it is not found on your login shell's `PATH`.
